summary: W17 is the first v4.4 three-run week (Adj #244): Mon LONG 70 min / Tue Hyp A / Wed T 6×1K / Thu OFF / Fri VO2 5×1000m @ I / Sat Hyp B lift-only / Sun OFF. Target ~20 mpw, the peak under the new template. Monday carries the whole week — it is W17's entire easy fraction, so a yellow §11.C read trims it in minutes and never moves it; Sun is off by rule and there is no punt slot. MONDAY DELIVERED: 70:42 / 7.39 mi @ 9:34/mi, RPE "very easy" — the first long in its programmed slot since W13 after three straight weeks lost (Adj #254). HILL STRIDES REMOVED from the program the same day — program.md now v4.5, no stride slot in any future brief, and §6 carries no lower-body neuromuscular work at all (Adj #255). One watch off the long: miles 7-8 ran 8:36/9:04 below the easy band by choice, at roughly threshold cardiac cost — noise once, a conversation if it repeats at the W18 Mon long (Adj #256). TUESDAY DELIVERED, and it was the best lift day of the Build: the deload paid off exactly where it was supposed to — incline 155×5 came back at RIR 2, clearing the re-attempt gate on the nose and reproducing the W14 line rep-for-rep, so 160 fires W18 Tue with the guard re-registered tighter because 160 already owns miss #1 (Adj #257); the rear-delt posted the repeat RIR 4/4 the nudge protocol asks for, so 145 fires W18 (Adj #258); and the decline crunch put its first full Tue 3×12 at +10 on the board (Adj #262). The counterweight is the arm side — the pushdown's back half collapsed to its worst line at 27.5 in either slot and the preacher opener gave back its click, both on the most favorable Tuesday the slot gets, and the §10.A 2nd-movement decision that was due at the Tue brief went to the athlete (Adj #259/#260/#263). BOTH OPEN ITEMS SETTLED THE SAME EVENING BY DIRECTIVE, so the W18 brief carries neither: the 2nd biceps/triceps movement is PAUSED short-term — preacher + pushdown only with no brief line until it re-surfaces on its own at the W19 Tue brief 8-25, the 4-wk gate staying met and the eligibility banked; the pause buys three full-dose pushdown back-half reads (W17 Sat, W18 Tue, W18 Sat), and a second collapse turns W19 into a load/set-count conversation rather than an expansion (Adj #264/#266); and the DB lateral's soft-opener gate is resolved by taking option (a) — 30 → 35 fires W18 Tue, the opener-RIR condition retired rather than carried, dose unchanged at 6×12 with the last two to failure, reverting only if the front four can't hold the 12 floor (Adj #265). That puts THREE bumps on W18 Tue: incline 160, rear-delt 145, DB lateral 35. WEDNESDAY DELIVERED and it answered its question backwards: the 6×1K ran the 7:50 slow-end ask on the Build's longest T dose (28:49 of work) and came back RPE 7 flat across all six with "mega easy" attached, so the armed reopen toward SLOWER does not fire and disarms — the band 7:45-7:50 stands, but its slow end is now proven comfortable and T joins I as a candidate for being ~5 s/mi conservative, with the W19 cut-down arbitrating both (Adj #267). The athlete then settled the T half by directive the same evening — "we should go faster next T run" — so the band steps 7:45-7:50 to 7:40-7:45, which is not a new estimate but the heat-adjusted reserve Adj #166/#202 deliberately withheld (the W14 3K TT read VDOT 42.85 raw / ~43.5 heat-adjusted, in 80degF). The RPE <=7 anchor is unchanged and still governs, I stays 7:00-7:15 pending Friday, and the W19 cut-down still arbitrates; the first outing at the new band is W18 Wed's 4x1 mi with 90 s rest, opened on pace, reverting on RPE 8+ or a died rep (Adj #271). Cadence 168 throughout corrected the record too: the W16 in-band read was treadmill-specific, not threshold-specific, so the watch is armed at both modalities (Adj #269). That leaves Friday carrying more weight, not less: the 5×1000m @ I is the decisive band test — open at the 7:00 fast end, run the prescribed 90 s JOG recoveries after Sunday's walked ones, full ~17.5 min dose, and a sub-anchor read with the confound removed reopens the band ahead of the W19 cut-down (Adj #251/#252). Cadence watch re-armed at I, next read Fri (Adj #253). Saturday is the first full-dose Hyp B since the deload and fires both held bumps — DB lateral 35→40 (Adj #248) and seated calf 355→365 (Adj #249), whose AM Achilles gate reads Mon 8-17; its pushdown is also the re-read that governs the W18 2nd-movement call.

Rear-delt 140×15/15 RIR 4/4 — repeat under-load pattern → 145 fires W18 (Adj #258). Crunch first full Tue 3×12 at +10, 36 total — set-3 headroom still owed (Adj #262). Pushdown back half collapsed 12/12/8/8 RIR 2/0/0/0 = 40, worst at 27.5 either slot — hold (Adj #259); preacher 10/10/10/8 RIR 1/1/0/0, opener gave back its click — hold (Adj #263). Both open items then settled by athlete directive: §10.A 2nd biceps/triceps movement PAUSED short-term — re-surfaces at the W19 Tue brief 8-25, gate stays met and eligibility banked (Adj #264/#266); DB lateral Tue 30 → 35 fires W18, opener-RIR gate retired (Adj #265). All clean by default.

Logged — 6×1K @ T: 7:35/7:51/7:39/7:47/7:48/7:47, work avg 7:44/mi over 28:49, RPE 7 flat across all six, "mega easy". The Adj #241 reopen-toward-slower does NOT fire and DISARMS — band 7:45–7:50 stands, but its slow end reads sub-anchor at full dose, so T joins I as possibly conservative and the W19 cut-down arbitrates both (Adj #267). Third fast open, rep 1 7:35, reps 4–6 inside a 1-second window (Adj #268). Cadence 168 throughout — the Adj #241 clear was treadmill-specific (Adj #269). Recoveries decayed to walking, immaterial at 60 s/T (Adj #270). HR 166→186 drift, display-only. ~5.7 mi, road, Vomero Plus; all clean by default — 10th straight quality outing clean. T BAND THEN STEPPED by athlete directive the same evening — 7:45–7:50 → 7:40–7:45, releasing the heat-adjusted reserve Adj #166/#202 withheld; RPE ≤7 anchor unchanged, row split 1:52–1:57, first outing W18 Wed 4×1 mi opened on pace (Adj #271).
